newsitem.title: USA: Drypers buys Brazilian diaper brand.
newsitem.headline: Drypers buys Brazilian diaper brand.

text.p: Drypers Corp said on Tuesday it acquired the Puppet brand of diapers and certain other assets from Chansommes do Brasil.
The company said it bought Puppet, the third largest selling diaper brand in Brazil, in a series of transactions with an aggregate value of more than $12 million in cash, equipment and stock.
Drypers believes the transaction will have a nominally accretive effect on earnings in the first and second quarters of 1997 and will be accretive to earnings in the second half of the year.

Drypers formed a joint venture with Brazilian financial investors, of which it holds 51 percent, to market and distribute Puppet diapers in Brazil. The company said it has an option to buy the remaining joint venture interest.
